title: Debugging Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff
prompt: During a Helm/ArgoCD rollout of a 12-replica checkout service, ExternalSecrets Operator failed to sync `checkout-db-creds-v2` (IAM typo) while `checkout-flags-v2` was marked `optional: true`. Pods hit `CreateContainerConfigError` and `CrashLoopBackOff` (10s -> 5m), and `maxUnavailable: 50%` killed 6 healthy pods—halving checkout capacity. Prevent capacity loss.

spark.summary: Missing non-optional Secrets block pods in `CreateContainerConfigError`, `optional: true` ConfigMaps cause `CrashLoopBackOff`, and `maxUnavailable: 50%` terminates healthy replicas during broken rollouts.
spark.keyTakeaway: When a single bottleneck threatens end-to-end availability, enforce `maxUnavailable: 0` with `maxSurge: 25%`, remove `optional: true` on required configs, order ExternalSecrets via ArgoCD SyncWaves, and validate manifests in CI.

learningJourney.markdownContent:
```yaml
spec:
  replicas: 12
  progressDeadlineSeconds: 180
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0     # Never drop below 12 healthy pods
      maxSurge: 25%         # Surge up to 15 pods during rollout
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: checkout
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: checkout-db-creds-v2
                optional: false
            - configMapRef:
                name: checkout-flags-v2
                optional: false
```
